map.算法：ΔL = L₂−L₁、Δa = a₂−a₁、Δb = b₂−b₁；色差 Δ: Algorithm: Delta L = L2-L1, Delta a = a2-a1, Delta b = b2-b1; color difference Delta E = sqrt(Delta L^2+Delta a^2+Delta b^2) (CIELAB 76); chroma difference Delta C = sqrt(a2^2+b2^2) - sqrt(a1^2+b1^2); hue difference Delta H = sqrt(max(0, Delta E^2-Delta L^2-Delta C^2)); grey-scale grade by Delta E: <=0.4->5, <=1.2->4-5, <=2.0->4, <=3.0->3-4, <=4.0->3, <=5.6->2, else 1; pass if Delta E <= threshold.
map.例：标准样 L=50/a=20/b=10，试样 L=52/a=18/b=13，阈: Example: standard L=50/a=20/b=10, sample L=52/a=18/b=13, threshold 1.5 -> Delta L=2.00, Delta a=-2.00, Delta b=3.00, Delta E=4.12, Delta C=-0.16, Delta H=3.60, grey scale grade 2, verdict: Fail (exceeds threshold 1.5). If sample changed to L=51/a=20.5/b=10.5 -> Delta E=1.22, Delta C=0.67, Delta H=0.22, grade 4, verdict: Pass. If only brightness changes L=51.5 with a,b unchanged -> Delta E=1.50, Delta C=0, Delta H=0, grade 4-5, right on the threshold boundary, a borderline case, re-test advised.
